sources.title: GitHub - ncoevoet/facet: Local AI photo scoring, culling, and gallery ...
sources.snippet: AI culling apps (Aftershoot, Narrative, FilterPixel) are polished commercial cullers, often with editing built in. Facet is free, local, broader (gallery, search, faces), and its scoring is tunable — but it is a single-developer project without their support or RAW editing.
